Timing of the US housing-turnover / mortgage-rate inflection -- the $10.1B ADG+FBM pivot did NOT diversify away from that cycle, it levered INTO it (mgmt restated the exposure on the 2026-08-19 call: "ADG 100% exposed, FBM about 45% exposed to residential construction as we look at homebuilding, single-family, multifamily, well documented that it's bumping along at multiyear lows."), and the FY2026 guide has now been cut to the BOTTOM of every leg, so the DIY core, the acquisitions' payback AND the remaining guide cushion all hinge on the same single variable.
